Judgment casts doubt on evidence linking aid workers to Hamas and says humanitarian efforts in Gaza were damaged A UN tribunal has cast doubt on the evidence used to justify the sacking of Palestinian UN aid workers in 2024, saying it was based “almost entirely” on unproven assertions from the Israeli government and had damaged humanitarian operations in Gaza.
The judgment, seen by the Guardian, raises fresh questions about the decision by the UN Relief and Works Agency (Unrwa), the main humanitarian organisation working in Gaza, to sack members of staff.

items.title: Art of play in the age of AI

sentences.en: Art of play in the age of AI.
As kids, we spent hours tinkering and building and just messing with things.
As an adult, I could watch my own young kiddos figure out how certain shapes and movement work all day.
Through that play, we improved our problem-solving and language skills, and it s probably not a stretch to say it was good for our early engineering skills.
In this era of development now, we re starting to get a taste of that again.
We re experimenting more, and taking in more changes, because it s all new!
For the last four years at GitHub Universe, we ve had hackable conference badges.
What started as a simple e-ink display for your name and job title morphed into a labor of love for Martin Woodward , VP of Developer Relations.
This year, the badge evolved into a device with a color screen, rechargeable battery, accelerometer sensors, and touch-sensitive gaming controls.
The tinkering we ve seen with the badges has been amazing.
